SourceProxy.label: SHYX Skeleton Extraction
SourceProxy.name: SHYXSkeletonExtraction

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Skeleton Extraction: Extracts a curve skeleton from a closed triangle mesh.

SourceProxy.Documentation:
This filter extracts a 1D curve skeleton from a closed triangulated surface mesh using the CGAL Mean Curvature Flow Skeletonization algorithm. The input mesh must be watertight. The output is a set of polylines representing the medial skeleton of the shape.
Optional **Append Cap Endpoints**: after extraction, each connected patch of cells whose cap array (default cell **EndpointIndex**) first component is greater than 0 is reduced to an area-weighted centroid and joined to the nearest point on the skeleton (existing vertex, or a new vertex that splits that edge). If that vertex already has line degree > 1, the stub is a new branch rather than a leaf extension: those lines are marked 1 on cell-data **NewCapBranch** and a warning is issued (other cells 0). Use on capped meshes (e.g. after Vessel End Clipper). Off by default.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MaxTriangleAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Max Triangle Angle (deg)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Local remeshing parameter. Triangles with an angle larger than this value may be split during contraction (CGAL max_triangle_angle). Unit is degrees.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MinEdgeLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Min Edge Length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Local remeshing parameter. Edges shorter than this value may be collapsed during contraction (CGAL min_edge_length). Automatic length is 0.001 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (matches ParaView BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The property's initial value is 0 for that rule; values <= 0 use it as well. The panel shows scale and reset controls when a BoundsDomain is present.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: AreaThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Area Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Area variation factor controlling convergence precision. Smaller values produce finer skeletons but take longer.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: QualitySpeedTradeoff
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Quality / Speed Tradeoff (w_H)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Controls contraction speed and approximation quality (CGAL quality_speed_tradeoff, w_H). Smaller values converge faster but may reduce skeleton quality.

IntVectorProperty.name: MediallyCentered
IntVectorProperty.label: Medially Centered
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, a medial centering step is applied to improve skeleton quality. This produces better results but takes more time.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MediallyCenteredSpeedTradeoff
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Medial Centering Tradeoff (w_M)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Controls smoothness of medial approximation (CGAL medially_centered_speed_tradeoff, w_M). Higher values move the skeleton closer to the medial axis but may slow convergence. Only used if MediallyCentered is ON.

IntVectorProperty.name: AppendCapEndpoints
IntVectorProperty.label: Append Cap Endpoints
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, after skeleton extraction, each connected patch of cells whose cap array (default **EndpointIndex**) first component is > 0 is reduced to an area-weighted centroid. A line is inserted from that centroid to the nearest point on the skeleton. If the closest location is the interior of an edge, a vertex is inserted and that edge is split so the stub is connected. If the attach vertex has line degree > 1, this is a new branch (not extending a leaf): the stub is marked 1 on cell-data **NewCapBranch** and a warning lists the attach degrees. Other skeleton cells are 0. Intended for capped meshes (e.g. after Vessel End Clipper). No-op if the array is missing or has no positive cells.

StringVectorProperty.name: CapEndpointArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Cap array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Cell-centered array identifying cap / opening faces (default **EndpointIndex**). Cells whose first component is > 0 form the patches (wall is typically -1). The picker lists cell arrays only so EndpointIndex resolves to cell data when a same-named point array also exists.
